limitations: Available fixture bitmap; captures counts frame binding, not an OS capture.

Markers and detector assertions add instrumentation overhead to both paths; the script marker wrapper also parses each JSON request.
Process CPU and heap snapshots are observational; they include warmup and runtime setup, are not allocation or battery profiles.
Script diagnostics event recording and visible diagnostic UI were not exercised in this comparison.
QuickJS and the detector share one dedicated dispatcher in this isolated collection; production uses Dispatchers.Default for JS and a serial resource dispatcher for Android operations.
